name: Tupferl Bar Bistro
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Tupferl Bar Bistro in Brixen im Thale** – your cozy retreat in the heart of the **Tiroler** Alps.

Savor authentic **Tiroler** flavors in a warm, rustic setting. Our menu features hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh mountain trout, and homemade **Apfelstrudel**, paired with local craft beers and fine wines.

Whether you're unwinding after a day of hiking or skiing in the **Kitzbühel** Alps, or simply enjoying the charm of **Brixen im Thale**, we’re here to make your visit unforgettable.

**Come see us in the center of Brixen im Thale** – where good food, great drinks, and alpine hospitality meet.
